runtime_conditions: Use synthetic fixtures/disposable owned database only; no production or remote mutation.
No secrets passed to dependency lifecycle; all lifecycle remains disabled. Runtime credentials must be private temporary least-privilege and invalidated at shutdown.

Only provider can set filtersApplied flags after authoritative database predicates/paging/projection. Never forward client-supplied flags or raw SQL into in-memory query engines.
Project truthful capabilities and reject untested PBF/renderer/edit/token routes; false pagination metadata is discarded by inherited normalization and global overrides do not suppress all defaults.
Sanitize runtime NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH/config inputs; node-config imported config overrides constructor settings. Record actual effective limits and endpoints.
Actual successful install/runtime/DB pushdown/authorization/revocation/limits/output tests remain required and cannot be inferred from this review.
